answer: Willow-Root Cluster Attestation. Each agent joins a cluster whose members co-sign a shared meadow of interaction logs; a new identity requires 3 existing clusters to independently attest it, and each attestation consumes a crystal of limited monthly attestation quota that clusters cannot mint. Quota scarcity caps how many identities any coalition can spawn per period, and clusters that attest identities later flagged as duplicate lose quota permanently. Attackers must recruit many independent quota holders, paying coordination and reputation risk per identity.
